dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hand to ear, a listening pose.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, are you telling them to listen for any movement? Mm, yeah, that's definitely a vital skill when we're on the move.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As expected of Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy! They settled down immediately, and it looks like they're feeling the vibrations through the earth with their little feet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The way we're working together now, Paimon would bet bottom Mora that we could be ready for danger long before it ever shows up!
